description: Preview commissioning repeated upkeep at a real place: for each need, whether the board has governed work for it and what authority it needs (a permit or licence is never waived), the dated cycles, the measurement the Vealth Standard itself asks for, and how much NET you would need to hold against what your wallet already owes elsewhere. Site authority you declare stays unverified until a human verifier confirms it; NET figures are house references, not an executable price; nothing is recorded, posted, signed, reserved or paid. Free, keyless, moves no money.

commission.description: commissionId, principal (your wallet address, never a key), place {name,lat,lng}, siteAuthority {kind: owner|manager|association|public_ground, evidenceRef}, needs[{id,objective,everyCycles,conditionId?}], cycles (1-12), cycleDays (7-365), startAt (ISO).
